title: 6.4.19 Challenges
description: Pick one (or more) Animation & Camera stretches: parallax background, mirror the sprite when it walks left, or add vertical camera follow. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Set up a player and at least one platform
steps.instructions: You need somewhere to start: a canvas, a player sprite, and at least one static platform. Anything beyond that is up to the challenge you pick.
hints: Re-read 6.4.11 Reading for the camera follow pattern.

steps.title: Make the camera follow
steps.instructions: Inside draw(), assign camera.x from the player's x so the level can scroll.
hints: See 6.4.16 Worked Example: Camera Follow if you need a refresher.

steps.title: Pick a stretch from content.md
steps.instructions: Implement at least one: a parallax background (a second sprite at a lower layer that moves slower), mirroring the sprite with mirrorX when walking left, or vertical camera follow.
hints: content.md describes three stretches with hints for each: pick whichever interests you.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: Call background(...) inside draw() so old frames don't pile up.
hints: Search the moSHion docs drawer for background().

requirements.title: Camera follows something
requirements.description: Inside draw(), assign camera.x or camera.y in a way that depends on a sprite's position (or uses lerp).

requirements.title: Use one stretch feature
requirements.description: Use at least one of: a sprite.layer assignment (parallax / depth), scale.x = -1 (mirror sprite when walking left), or camera.y inside draw() (vertical follow).
